description: This file contains utility functions for collection operations within Apache Spark, including methods for taking ordered elements, merging sorted iterators, converting sequences to options, and creating maps efficiently.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A singleton object providing collection utility functions for Spark.

methods.name: takeOrdered
methods.description: Returns the first K elements from the input iterator according to the specified ordering, maintaining order.

methods.name: mergeOrdered
methods.description: Merges multiple sorted iterators into a single sorted iterator, assuming all inputs are sorted by the same ordering.

methods.name: sequenceToOption
methods.description: Converts a sequence of options to an option of sequence, returning Some if all elements are defined.

methods.name: toMap
methods.description: Creates a map from two iterables of keys and values with performance optimizations.

methods.name: toJavaMap
methods.description: Creates an unmodifiable Java Map from two iterables of keys and values with performance optimizations.
